## Implementation status record

- [ ] Updated the relevant subsystem document or added a focused PR progress record.
- [ ] Recorded PR scope, dependencies, branch/base, and current HEAD SHA.
- [ ] Marked each requirement IMPLEMENTED / PARTIAL / NOT IMPLEMENTED / BLOCKED.
- [ ] Listed changed source files and relevant functions.
- [ ] Listed remaining work, blockers, and next safe action.
- [ ] Recorded test/build/QEMU results with exact tested SHA and evidence links.
- [ ] Distinguished source inspection, tests created, tests executed, and runtime verification.
- [ ] Confirmed prior merged functionality and regression risks.
- [ ] Kept the PR open and draft while applicable completion gates remain.
